parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Notica destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-notica` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `noticas://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available. The free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. The `gateway` and `gateway-plus` transformer channels instead compose the native Notica push URL from your stored token and POST a form-encoded payload directly, bypassing Apprise: `gateway` is free (direct to your Notica push token), and `gateway-plus` is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment Notica destinations.
